COVENANT DEFINITION — locked 2026-08-12, Stage 16.5, file 00r-what-is-a-covenant.md (commit cba470e).

berit (Hebrew) / diatheke (Greek). A covenant = a solemn, binding RELATIONSHIP established by commitments or promises — parties, obligations, signs, blessings, consequences, sometimes oath or sacrifice. Idiom: one CUTS a covenant (karat berit), tying covenant to sacrifice at vocabulary level (Gen 15's divided animals).

CORE DISTINCTION: THE COVENANT IS NOT IDENTICAL TO THE COMMANDMENTS ASSOCIATED WITH IT. A covenant contains obligations; obligations are not its definition.

SEVEN TERMS HELD APART (conflating = Category Collapse): COVENANT (the relational arrangement) / PROMISE (what Yahweh commits to accomplish) / COMMANDMENT (what Yahweh commands) / COVENANT OBLIGATION-STIPULATION (what a particular arrangement requires) / COVENANT SIGN (visible marker) / COVENANT BLESSING / COVENANT CURSE.

SHARPENING: covenant != promise. A covenant contains promises but is more relational and structured. EVERY COVENANT INVOLVES COMMITMENTS; NOT EVERY PROMISE IS A COVENANT.

'SHABBAT IS THE COVENANT' IS IMPRECISE — Shabbat is named a covenant SIGN (Ex 31:17), as are the rainbow (Gen 9:12-13) and circumcision (Gen 17:11). NOTE FOR THE LATER SHABBAT STAGE, DELIBERATELY NOT CASHED: Ex 31:17 roots Shabbat in CREATION, not only Sinai.

EIGHT STRUCTURAL QUESTIONS for any covenant: parties / relationship established / Yahweh's promise / required response / sign / blessings-curses / duration / purpose in the developing story.

MAJOR FINDING THE SIDEBAR PRODUCED: BERIT OLAM attaches to THREE institutions — RAINBOW (Gen 9:16), CIRCUMCISION (Gen 17:13), SHABBAT (Ex 31:16). Same Hebrew phrase. NO tradition treats all three identically: nobody says the rainbow covenant ended; the apostles didn't require circumcision of Gentiles; Shabbat is contested. This STRENGTHENS the OLAM brake, does not relieve it — the phrase alone cannot settle any case. EXPLICITLY DOES NOT MEAN olam = 'temporary' (that's the Anti-Replacement error, swapping one rigid reading for its opposite). It means olam is NOT the load-bearing word everyone assumes. Removes the temptation to treat one lexical verdict as decisive for circumcision + Shabbat + Ezekiel 37's sanctuary simultaneously.
TRANSLATION INCONSISTENCY: ESV renders the identical phrase 'everlasting covenant' (Gen 9:16, 17:13) but 'covenant forever' (Ex 31:16). CJB: 'perpetual' at Ex 31:16, 'everlasting' at Gen 17:13. RVR1960 most consistent: 'perpetuo' both places.

NEW FORMAL RULE — THE COVENANT RELATIONSHIP RULE (now in 00b + 00-methodology-current as rule 5): LATER COVENANT != AUTOMATIC CANCELLATION of preceding covenants. EARLIER COVENANT != every feature retaining identical administration forever. SCRIPTURE MUST TELL US THE RELATIONSHIP; NEVER INFERRED FROM SEQUENCE ALONE. Decisive test case = THE RAINBOW, precisely because it's uncontroversial: nobody argues circumcision replaced the rainbow covenant, and the ONLY reason is that Scripture never says so. WARRANT: Galatians 3:17 — the law 'came 430 years afterward, does not annul a covenant previously ratified by God.' Paul himself reasons that later covenantal/legal development does not automatically nullify an earlier divine promise.

'ADDENDUM' INTUITION MODIFIED NOT REJECTED: addendum implies terms appended to one unchanged contract. The biblical form is Gal 3:17 — a claim about PROMISES NOT BEING ANNULLED. Covenant sequence: Noah (rainbow) -> Abraham (circumcision) -> Sinai (Torah/priesthood/sanctuary/sacrifice) -> David (house/throne/kingdom) -> New (Jer 31). Noah wasn't a failed first attempt; Sinai isn't 'Abraham 2.0'; David doesn't erase Abraham. Story becomes MORE SPECIFIC, concentrating toward Messiah. BUT Jeremiah adds what accumulation alone can't hold: a covenant genuinely BROKEN — yet Yahweh does NOT say everything prior is canceled. Continuity and discontinuity both preserved; neither half swallows the other. The Stage 15 refinement SURVIVES and is strengthened: 'one covenantal story containing multiple covenants, culminating in Messiah.'

TWO CJB TRANSLATION DATA RECORDED NOT ADOPTED: (1) diatheke rendered 'oath' at Gal 3:17 — interpretive, Greek is not horkos; (2) CJB inserts 'the legal part of the Torah' twice where ESV/RVR1960 read simply 'the law' — importing the very moral/civil/ceremonial-style partition that Category Collapse's SECOND FACE flags as theological taxonomy rather than biblical terminology.

REFRAMES STAGE 17 RETROACTIVELY: the circumcision question is NOT 'did Yahweh repeal a rule?' but 'WHAT HAPPENED TO THE SIGN'S COVENANTAL BOUNDARY-MARKER FUNCTION?' — which is why 00q section 20's classification produced NO row reading 'abolished'; every row describes a CHANGE IN FUNCTION.

SEQUENCE NOTE (ADR-0007 demonstration): 00r was written AFTER 00q but is numbered Stage 16.5 because the spine records ARGUMENT order while file letters record CREATION order. Nothing in Stage 17 was rewritten to pretend this came first. The two architectures are allowed to disagree — that is why both exist.

*** READ 00-methodology-current.md FIRST. NEW: ADR-0009 THREE CONTENT PROVENANCE LAYERS — CLASSIFY EVERY TRANCHE AGAINST ALL THREE ***
1. MAIN ARGUMENT / EXPOSITION -> chapter prose (textual, lexical, historical, intertextual, theological evidence)
2. MANUSCRIPT VOICE -> first-person reflection: journey, corrections, discoveries, uncertainty, changing confidence. Candidate for DIRECT inclusion; capture inline (ADR-0004)
3. RESEARCHER'S COMMENTARY (NEW, mark as 'Researcher's Commentary') -> HOW a conclusion was EARNED: initial intuitions, objections, counterarguments, FAILED EXPLANATIONS, methodological brakes, surprising discoveries, WHY a reading was upgraded or downgraded. DO NOT auto-convert to manuscript prose. DO NOT discard after extracting the conclusion. PRESERVE THE SEQUENCE of discoveries/corrections. Later feeds endnotes, 'From the Research Notebook' boxes, appendices, annotated edition.
ASK EVERY TRANCHE: Does this advance the argument? Is it Manuscript Voice? Does it expose important Researcher's Commentary? MAY QUALIFY FOR MORE THAN ONE.
PRINCIPLE: PRESERVE EVERYTHING NOW, CURATE LATER. Storage cheap, reconstruction expensive/impossible. The manuscript pass is a DIFFERENT ACTIVITY (composition, not excavation) — do not do the former while doing the latter.
ORTHOGONAL TO ADR-0006, NOT A REPLACEMENT: ADR-0006 = rhetorical form inside a chapter (Main Exposition / Exegetical Sidebar / Author's Reflection). ADR-0009 = provenance + destination. An Author's Reflection is typically Manuscript Voice; RESEARCHER'S COMMENTARY HAS NO ADR-0006 FORM AT ALL, which is why it needed its own designation.
EXTERNAL TOOLING NOTE: git-backed Markdown vault remains the SINGLE canonical source of truth. ChatGPT sources/branches = live laboratory, NOT a store of record (would create competing sources of truth). Branching maps onto ADR-0007 side branches — only what survives returns to the spine.

STAGE 18.8 = 00u-acts-21-paul-torah-and-the-two-groups.md. FIRST FILE UNDER ADR-0009, demonstrating all three layers.
- Acts 21:20 'many thousands' Jewish believers 'ALL ZEALOUS FOR THE LAW' (CJB 'tens of thousands... zealots for the Torah') DECADES after the council, called believers WITHOUT qualification. So Acts 15 did NOT produce an assembly treating Torah observance as incompatible with faith in Messiah.
- Accusation = APOSTASIA (Acts 21:21), that Paul teaches Jews to APOSTATIZE FROM MOSES. James does NOT endorse it — proposes a PUBLIC DEMONSTRATION, stated purpose 'that all will know there is nothing in what they have been told about you, but that you yourself also live in observance of the law' (21:24). Luke records Paul doing it (21:26). NOT AN INFERENCE — the purpose is stated in the text.
- Nazirite identification: HIGHLY PLAUSIBLE, NOT NAMED by Luke. Explicit: Temple purification + offerings, and Paul participates.

*** CANONICAL RESEARCHER'S COMMENTARY (00u section 5) — the sacrifice problem, three attempts ***
ATTEMPT 1 accommodation ('Paul put his money where his mouth is'): partly right; Luke's stated purpose supports the demonstration half. BRAKE ON THE WORD 'TECHNICALITY' — makes Paul sound deceptive ('I don't believe this but I'll perform it'), an integrity problem the text doesn't create. REFRAMED: Paul practices what remains PERMISSIBLE for him as a Jew without treating it as necessary for justification or imposing it on Gentiles — doesn't require Paul to be pretending.
ATTEMPT 2 segregate offering types ('only a non-atoning vow offering'): *** KILLED BY NUMBERS 6:14 — THE NAZIRITE COMPLETION INCLUDES A SIN OFFERING *** (plus burnt, peace, grain, drink, wave). Convenient solution FAILS; tension real again.
WHAT THE FAILURE EXPOSED (why it was worth preserving): the attempt ASSUMED 'sacrifice' is ONE CATEGORY. IT ISN'T. This project had been flattening it exactly the way it warns against flattening everything else.
ATTEMPT 3 narrow the question: Levitical CHATTAT is often better understood as a PURIFICATION offering (ritual impurity, childbirth, bodily conditions, sanctuary purification), so modern 'sin offering = eternal guilt forgiven' is itself too crude. THEREFORE participating in a rite containing a chattat does NOT automatically establish Paul sought an alternative to Messiah. SURGICAL QUESTION LEFT OPEN (q42): what function did the Numbers 6 purification offering perform, and could Jewish believers continue such rites while regarding Messiah's sacrifice as the unique completed basis of ultimate atonement?

*** TWO CORRECTIONS ***
1. MESSIAH IS NOT EXCLUSIVELY THE 'SIN OFFERING'. NT uses MULTIPLE patterns: sin/purification (Heb 9:26, 10:12) / GUILT OFFERING ASHAM (Isa 53:10) / YOM KIPPUR-Lev 16 (Heb 9:12) / PASSOVER (1 Cor 5:7). AND He is SIMULTANEOUSLY THE PRIEST (Heb 9:14 'offered himself'), which Leviticus never permits (priest != sacrifice). The Levitical system DISTRIBUTES among multiple offices/sacrifices/rituals what CONVERGES in Messiah — confirms pattern->reality needs no one-to-one mechanical correspondence. 'Once-for-all sacrifice for sins' describes FINALITY without collapsing into one Levitical category.
2. THIS PROJECT'S OWN WORDING (Stage 16 / 00p section 9): 'because yesterday's offering did not finish anything' OVERREACHED. Hebrews says they could not PERFECT worshipers or FINALLY take away sins — NOT that they accomplished nothing. LEVITICUS 4:20/26/35: 'the priest shall make atonement for them, and THEY SHALL BE FORGIVEN.' CORRECTED MODEL: the Levitical sacrifices accomplished the covenantal/purificatory purposes Yahweh assigned them, but not the final once-for-all removal + perfection + access Hebrews attributes to Messiah. THIS STRENGTHENS pattern->reality: they were REAL institutions accomplishing assigned purposes, NOT fake, NOT mistakes, NOT useless rituals awaiting abolition. Original wording preserved in 00p with amendment note.

- 1 COR 9:19-22 as PAULINE CONTROL on accommodation ('to the Jews I became as a Jew'). BUT we do NOT announce it explains Acts 21 — Paul never connects them. Raises plausibility, doesn't establish.
- PAUL SAYS 'I AM A PHARISEE' PRESENT TENSE (Acts 23:6), and 24:14 'I worship the God of our fathers, BELIEVING EVERYTHING laid down by the Law and written in the Prophets' — AFTER following Yeshua. Acts 17:2 reasons in synagogue FROM THE TANAKH (no completed NT existed). So his claim is NOT 'Moses was wrong, Yeshua replaced him' but 'Moses and the Prophets were POINTING TOWARD Messiah'. Not Judaism->abandon Israel->Christianity, but Israel's Scriptures->promises->Messiah->fulfillment.
- ACTS 21:25 James EXPLICITLY DISTINGUISHES the two groups. Strong evidence the early assembly didn't erase Jewish/Gentile covenantal distinctions on faith. BUT DO NOT OVERSTATE: Eph 2:14 'he has made both one'. UNITY IS REAL — it just doesn't require IDENTICAL PRACTICE in every respect.
- TIMOTHY/TITUS/ACTS 21 = ONE COHERENT PATTERN: circumcision not a condition of Gentile justification; Jewish covenantal practice not thereby condemned. Real pressure on reading Galatians as 'circumcision is now wicked' — the surgical act isn't the issue, THE CLAIM ATTACHED IS.
- READING B OF ACTS 15:21 DOWNGRADED (not deleted): years later James still distinguishes Torah-zealous Jewish believers from Gentiles for whom the decree remains the stated judgment, rather than 'by now they should all be observant'. NOT IMPOSSIBLE. LESS SUPPORTED. Confidence changed by later canonical evidence.
- FIVE STRONG CONCLUSIONS + FOUR PRESERVED TENSIONS (Temple offerings vs once-for-all / whether Luke portrays Torah-zeal neutrally or as immature transitional practice / Gentile obligation beyond the decree / AD 70 which RECONNECTS TO MATTHEW 24).
- BLOCKS THE HISTORICAL MISTAKE 'Yeshua came -> Judaism ended -> Christianity began'. Peter goes to Temple, Paul to synagogue 'as was his custom', Jewish believers stay Torah-zealous decades on. Gentile inclusion is THE CONTROVERSY precisely because the movement exists INSIDE Israel's covenantal world first.

NEW GLOSSARY: IMPLY vs INFER — 'THE TEXT IMPLIES; THE READER INFERS'. Project has operated this since Stage 1 without naming it; naming matters because the conflation is HOW AN INFERENCE QUIETLY ACQUIRES THE AUTHORITY OF A STATEMENT.
NEW BOOKMARK (q43): HYPO NOMON. 'Under law' can't simply mean 'obeying any Torah command' — Paul quotes Torah as authoritative, calls it holy (Rom 7:12), condemns idolatry/theft, AND practices Jewish observance in Acts 21. 1 Cor 9:20 makes it HARDER not easier: became 'as one under the law (THOUGH NOT BEING MYSELF UNDER THE LAW)' while in Acts 21 living in observance of the law. Any definition must accommodate both. Needs a nomos study, not English slogans.

NEXT: COLOSSIANS 2:16-23 — places food + drink + festival + new moon + Sabbath inside the SHADOW/SUBSTANCE framework; exactly the evidence capable of strengthening/weakening/modifying the accommodation reading. TWO QUESTIONS ALREADY OPEN THERE (q35): soma at 2:17 (ESV 'substance' abstract vs CJB/RVR1960 'body', POSSIBLY THE BODY OF MESSIAH); and whether 'let no one JUDGE you' forbids THE OBSERVANCE or THE JUDGMENT. Also 2:20-23 explicitly names asceticism + 'human precepts'.
THEN: 1 Timothy 4 revisited with Acts 21 in mind.
THEN: STAGE 18 PROVISIONAL VERDICT — what the evidence strongly establishes / what it leans toward / what remains genuinely uncertain / AND WHAT CANNOT RESPONSIBLY BE CLAIMED.
THEN: SHABBAT — probably the next major covenant-sign test.
FUTURE BRANCH FLAGGED: NUMBERS 6 OFFERING-BY-OFFERING, to determine what Paul may actually have participated in, BEFORE deciding whether Acts 21 conflicts with Hebrews — or whether the conflict is being MANUFACTURED by importing a later flattened definition of 'sacrifice'.

Vault standard is Yeshua HaMashiach (not YahuShua) — user is aware of/has used the YahuShua transliteration but explicitly decided 2026-08-08 to keep Yeshua as the vault's standing term. Do not silently switch if it comes up again — this was a deliberate choice, not an oversight.
